items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I went to an Ed Shaughnessy rehearsal... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: Not many people do that. In fact I don't know anybody that does these days.
I went to an Ed Shaughnessy rehearsal and wasn't quite as square. It was more like a sloppy circle, but it was that principle.
